environment.description: EKS 1.29 pod in Fargate profile with IMDSv2 enforced at launch template level (HttpTokens: required, HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 1). Pod service account annotated with IRSA role whose trust policy includes condition 'sts:SourceIdentity' matching pod identity. DynamoDB IAM policy includes fine-grained access control via condition key 'dynamodb:LeadingKeys' restricting GetItem to items where partition key (tenant_id) matches '${aws:PrincipalTag/tenant_id}' from the IRSA session tag. Additionally, a Cilium L7 NetworkPolicy is applied with DNS-aware egress rules that only permit resolution of *.internal.corp and dynamodb.us-east-1.amazonaws.com, dropping all other DNS queries at the pod level. The Cilium agent runs with identity-aware enforcement using per-endpoint BPF programs compiled with the FQDN policy cache TTL set to 5s.
